description: MacBook Pro 14-inch M1 Pro (j314s, t6000) on mx-mac
source: omarchy-m-test --record against tests/corpus/m1-pro-mx-mac/ (scrubbed). Real evidence from the M1 Pro, 2026-09-12: reviews/pr-9835/m1-hardware.log and m1-validation.md (uname, model, PCI, Hyprland input devices, Wi-Fi address). No kernel log or device-tree dump of the M1 exists yet; the v0.1 dogfood run records them. The package, encryption, first-boot, mac-check, GPU, battery and CPU answers were never captured on the M1: they are reconstructed from what is known of the install (mx-mac, GRUB, linux-asahi) and noted as such. The inventory answers come from the booted kernel's own package, linux-asahi 7.1.13.asahi1-1 and its headers (device tree, module aliases, build config). The M1 has since moved to the converged image, so its mx-mac answers (packages, encryption, mac-check, GPU tools, speaker services) can no longer be captured and stay reconstructed; tests/corpus/m1-pro-converged is its real run. The camera, function-key and ports answers are stand-ins, noted on each entry, until the next dogfood run records them.

n=0
for f in "$HOME"/.local/share/omarchy/default/hypr/*.lua "$HOME"/.local/share/omarchy/default/hypr/*.conf \
         "$HOME"/.config/hypr/*.lua "$HOME"/.config/hypr/*.conf; do
  [ -r "$f" ] || continue
  n=$((n + 1))
  { sed -e 's/--.*$//' -e 's/#.*$//' "$f" | tr -d ' \t' | tr '\n' ';'; echo; } |
    sed -e 's/^/;/' -e 's/hl\./\nhl./g' -e 's/;gesture=/\ngesture=/g' -e 's/;workspace_swipe=/\nworkspace_swipe=/g' |
    while IFS= read -r c; do
      case $c in
        'hl.gesture({'*)
          c=${c%%\}*}
          [ "$(field "$c" fingers)" = 3 ] || continue
          action=$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed -nE 's/.*action="([a-z]+)"([,;].*)?$/\1/p')
          case $action in workspace|unset) ;; *) action=other;; esac
          echo "gesture 3 $(field "$c" direction) $action";;
        'gesture=3,'*)

          old=$IFS; IFS=,; set -- $c; IFS=$old

for d in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do

  echo "usb $kind speed=$(cat "$d/speed") class=$class"
done
